column1: # The statement shapes of the slot matrix's SEQUENCE axis (scripts/slot_sequence.py,
# doc/claude/SLOT_MATRIX.md § The sequence axis).  A cell is a function of a few statements
# over one local `x` (and `y`, bound from `x`), ending in a tail; the generator draws them
# from the rows below and computes what the cell answers from the MODEL column.
# Columns, tab-separated: class, id, types (`*` or the type letters it is made for: p r e l),
#   class  src   a value of the local's type, the `<SRC>` of a bind
#          isrc  a value made in a loop pass, from `i`: the `<ISRC>` of a loop
#          ret   what an early `return` hands back: the `<RET>` of a statement
#          end   the cell's tail; one with `<PJ>` is also made as a projection of the type
# The loft names are those of scripts/syntax_sequence_prelude.loft; `<t>` is the type's letter.
# Holes numbered by the generator, the same in the loft and the model, left to right:
#   <LIT> an even record literal (a callee hands it back), <LITO> an odd one (a callee
#   replaces it), <N> an even number, <K> a branch's value of `k`; <ILIT> a literal numbered
#   i + 20; <PJ> the projection (empty when there is none), <RLIT> a literal of what the cell
# The model: p x y name the parameter and the locals; (mk n) a fresh record; (id e) e;
# (w e) a fresh record numbered e + 100 when e is odd, else e; (alt e) the same, or null;
# (?? a b); (if K a b) a when k == K; (pj e) the projection of e; (ilit) the loop's record;
# (set x e), (field e), (elem e), (bump x), (drop e…), (ret K e), (loop mint|pre|post src [e]).

column4: for i in 0..3 { if i == k { return <RET>; } x = <ISRC>; }
for i in 0..3 { x = <ISRC>; if i == k { return <RET>; } }
